title: [bug] IOS log are too verbose

labels.name: status: needs triage
labels.description: This issue needs to triage, applied to new issues

body: ### Describe the bug On IOS when using `tauri_plugin_log` logs are too verbose and it's not possible to see usefull logs because of it. According to @FabianLars it is not the expected behaviour One workaround is this add `.level(log::LevelFilter::Info)` ### Reproduction _No response_ ### Expected behavior _No response_ ### Full `tauri info` output ```text [✔] Environment - OS: Mac OS 15.5.0 arm64 (X64) ✔ Xcode Command Line Tools: installed ✔ rustc: 1.89.0 (29483883e 2025-08-04) ✔ cargo: 1.89.0 (c24e10642 2025-06-23) ✔ rustup: 1.28.2 (e4f3ad6f8 2025-04-28) ✔ Rust toolchain: stable-aarch64-apple-darwin (default) - node: 22.18.0 - pnpm: 10.14.0 - npm: 10.9.3 [-] Packages - tauri 🦀: git+https://github.com/saurL/tauri?branch=feat%2Fpush-notifications#75edc968c75664ccaa9a9c5c29943704008af8c9 (2.8.2) - tauri-build 🦀: No version detected - wry 🦀: 0.53.1 - tao 🦀: git+https://github.com/saurL/tao?branch=feat%2Fpush-notification#a62638b2af5b45dcca2af682ea469ebff90f8396 (0.34.2) - @tauri-apps/api : 2.8.0 - @tauri-apps/cli : 2.8.1 [-] Plugins - tauri-plugin-log 🦀: 2.6.0 - @tauri-apps/plugin-log : 2.6.0 - tauri-plugin-fs 🦀: 2.4.2 - @tauri-apps/plugin-fs : not installed! - tauri-plugin-deep-link 🦀: 2.4.1, (outdated, latest: 2.4.2) - @tauri-apps/plugin-deep-link : not installed! - tauri-plugin-http 🦀: 2.5.2 - @tauri-apps/plugin-http : not installed! - tauri-plugin-opener 🦀: 2.2.3, (outdated, latest: 2.5.0) - @tauri-apps/plugin-opener : not installed!
